verdict.rationale: Docs show task assignment/deadlines and cross-functional collaboration for evidence (docs-5/24), continuous monitoring and alerts (docs-3/25/12), and AI-powered evidence gap analysis checking relevance/scope/timeliness before audit submission (docs-28), which implies some expiry/staleness tracking. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'manual evidence' workflow with named owner fields, renewal reminder scheduling, or expiry-date tracking specific to manually uploaded artifacts. Missing for 10: explicit renewal-reminder feature for manual evidence, explicit expiry-date field/tracking UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
